title: Cantonese Bacon and Lardon Dim Sum
description: A delicious and savory Cantonese-inspired dim sum dish featuring crispy bacon and lardon, wrapped in a yeasty dough.
instructions: 1. Preheat a non-stick frying pan or wok over medium-high heat.
2. Cook the bacon and lardon until crispy. Remove from heat and set aside.
3. In a small bowl, mix together scallions, garlic, soy sauce, oyster sauce (if using), and sesame oil.
4. Lay a dim sum wrapper on a flat surface. Place a small spoonful of the scallion mixture in the center of the wrapper.
5. Add a few pieces of cooked bacon and lardon on top of the scallion mixture.
6. Brush the edges of the wrapper with a small amount of water.
7. Fold the wrapper into a triangle by bringing the two opposite corners together to form a point.
8. Press the edges together to seal the dim sum.
9. Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling ingredients.
10. Serve the Cantonese bacon and lardon dim sum hot with a side of Cantonese dipping sauce.
